title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 08
description:
Elevate any bedroom with this personalized Baseball Comforter Set from Jeminise, designed for sports enthusiasts. Crafted for comfort and style, this bedding set allows for custom touches, making it a unique addition to your home decor or a thoughtful gift.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating determination and passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features an environmental protection finishing process to hold dye and prevent fading, ensuring long-lasting vibrancy.
  • Material Details: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric for a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel, with whole-piece microfiber filling.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and can be air-dried without heat, maintaining its fluffiness.
  • Custom Options: Personalize with custom name text inputs to create a truly unique bedding set.
  • Breathable Design: Engineered with breathable properties for comfortable use across all seasons.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Set Name Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Included Components Duvet Cover
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization 2 text inputs
Thread Count 400
